--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.ArithmeticFunction
theorem card_divisors_mul {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m.Coprime n) :
    #(m * n).divisors = #m.divisors * #n.divisors := by
  simp only [← sigma_zero_apply, isMultiplicative_sigma.map_mul_of_coprime hmn]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Divisors
theorem mem_divisors_prime_pow {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (k : ℕ) {x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ divisors (p ^ k) ↔ ∃ j ≤ k, x = p ^ j := by
  rw [mem_divisors, Nat.dvd_prime_pow pp, and_iff_left (ne_of_gt (pow_pos pp.pos k))]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Finset.NatDivisors
/-- The divisors of a product of natural numbers are the pointwise product of the divisors of the
factors. -/
lemma Nat.divisors_mul (m n : ℕ) : divisors (m * n) = divisors m * divisors n := by
  ext k
  simp_rw [mem_mul, mem_divisors, dvd_mul, mul_ne_zero_iff, ← exists_and_left, ← exists_and_right]
  simp only [and_assoc, and_comm, and_left_comm]

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Antidiag.Nat
open card_pair_lcm_eq in
theorem card_pair_lcm_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : Squarefree n) :
    #{p ∈ (n.divisors ×ˢ n.divisors) | p.1.lcm p.2 = n} = 3 ^ ω n := by
  rw [← card_finMulAntidiag_of_squarefree hn, eq_comm]
  apply Finset.card_bij f (f_img hn) (f_inj) (f_surj hn.ne_zero)

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Divisors
theorem snd_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal {x : ℕ × ℕ} (h : x ∈ divisorsAntidiagonal n) :
    x.snd ∈ divisors n := by
  rw [mem_divisorsAntidiagonal] at h
  simp [Dvd.intro_left _ h.1, h.2]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Divisors
theorem pos_of_mem_divisors {m : ℕ} (h : m ∈ n.divisors) : 0 < m := by
  cases m
  · rw [mem_divisors, zero_dvd_iff (a := n)] at h
    cases h.2 h.1
  apply Nat.succ_pos

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Divisors
@[simp]
theorem mem_divisorsAntidiagonal {x : ℕ × ℕ} :
    x ∈ divisorsAntidiagonal n ↔ x.fst * x.snd = n ∧ n ≠ 0 := by
  simp only [divisorsAntidiagonal, Finset.mem_Ico, Ne, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
  rw [and_comm]
  apply and_congr_right
  rintro rfl
  constructor <;> intro h
  · contrapose! h
    simp [h]
  · rw [Nat.lt_add_one_iff, Nat.lt_add_one_iff]
    rw [mul_eq_zero, not_or] at h
    simp only [succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h.1), succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h.2),
      true_and]
    exact
      ⟨Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h.2),
        Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h.1)⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Factorization.PrimePow
theorem Nat.mul_divisors_filter_prime_pow {a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) :
    (a * b).divisors.filter IsPrimePow = (a.divisors ∪ b.divisors).filter IsPrimePow := by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
  · simp only [Nat.coprime_zero_left] at hab
    simp [hab, Finset.filter_singleton, not_isPrimePow_one]
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
  · simp only [Nat.coprime_zero_right] at hab
    simp [hab, Finset.filter_singleton, not_isPrimePow_one]
  ext n
  simp only [ha, hb, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Nat.mul_eq_zero, and_true, Ne,
    and_congr_left_iff, not_false_iff, Nat.mem_divisors, or_self_iff]
  apply hab.isPrimePow_dvd_mul

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Divisors
lemma divisors_filter_dvd_of_dvd {n m : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hm : m ∣ n) :
    {d ∈ n.divisors | d ∣ m} = m.divisors := by
  ext k
  simp_rw [mem_filter, mem_divisors]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨_, hkm⟩ ↦ ⟨hkm, ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hn hm⟩, fun ⟨hk, _⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨hk.trans hm, hn⟩, hk⟩⟩

/-- `divisors n` is the `Finset` of divisors of `n`. By convention, we set `divisors 0 = ∅`. -/
def divisors : Finset ℕ := {d ∈ Ico 1 (n + 1) | d ∣ n}

context.name: Finset.card
context.content:
/-- `s.card` is the number of elements of `s`, aka its cardinality.

The notation `#s` can be accessed in the `Finset` locale. -/
def card (s : Finset α) : ℕ :=
  Multiset.card s.1
